key_notes.2.6693333333333333: Board heading away up-right under the rider who leans toward the cone, drawn in the doodle's own side view with the nose lifted.
key_notes.2.8361666666666667: Board at its most turned-away, nose up; the cone grows on the left. The turn starts here.
key_notes.3.003: Anticipation: the board swings across as the cone comes level on the left; deck lengthening, nose coming down to level.
key_notes.3.1698333333333335: The line: board fully side-on, nose dipping right, as it carves past the cone at the left edge; the doodle's own side view.
key_notes.3.336666666666667: Settle after the pass: the carve deepens, nose down to the right at its steepest, the board moving left and down in frame.
key_notes.3.5035000000000003: Carve deepening: board moving down and left under the rider, nose down to the right.
key_notes.3.6703333333333332: Board starts back up out of the low point of the carve, nose lifting a little.
key_notes.3.8371666666666666: Rider comes upright and the board rises and flattens a little: the lean eases back.
key_notes.4.0040000000000004: Rider upright over the board; board level-ish and steady before the next shift of weight.
key_notes.4.170833333333333: Board steady low under the rider as the next carve begins.
key_notes.4.337666666666666: Board low again under the rider, nose down, as houses and parked vans pass behind.
key_notes.4.5045: Last frame: board rises and lengthens, flattening out as it rolls across toward the right.

assembly_summary: The original four-stroke skateboard rolls past a growing cone under its source-observed rider. Camera/background projection and the board remain separate; rider context is agent-drawn and not a native doodle.
bounded_repair_v2: V1 independent critic: far/right shoe floats. Repair only operator sole/lower-leg attachments: each sole follows the local upper edge of unchanged native deck at every observation. Preserve rider lean, board geometry/transform/wheels, cone and camera. Zero independently verified planted intervals remains zero.
